title: Zesty Crispy Ukrainian Beet Roast
description: A fermented and crispy Ukrainian dish featuring chives and roast, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this recipe is ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly and offers a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cubed beets to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beet mixture to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes.
While the beets are roasting, mix the chopped chives and apple cider vinegar in a small bowl.
After the beets have roasted for 20 minutes, remove the skillet from the oven and stir in the chive mixture.
Return the skillet to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 10 minutes, or until the beets are crispy.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let the beets cool for a few minutes before serving.
